instruction: Candid documentary medium-full shot in an indoor gym. The man in the green hoodie (R1) stands center-right, extending his arms forward with interlocked fingers to stretch, looking ahead. In the foreground left, the woman in the grey t-shirt (R2) stands with her back to the camera, facing him. Overhead gym lighting casts a natural glow over the scene, with training equipment softly blurred in the background.
